p1_b1.ocr: In the Powertrain Mix Overview, the units sold for 2020 were 15,000 electric, 5,000 hybrid, and 30,000 internal combustion, totaling 50,000 sales with a market share of 30% and a growth rate of 10%. In 2021, units sold increased to 20,000 electric, 7,000 hybrid, and 25,000 internal combustion, leading to total sales of 52,000 with a market share of 38%. The growth rate for this year was 12%. For 2022, the figures rose to 25,000 electric, 10,000 hybrid, and 20,000 internal combustion, totaling 55,000 sales, marking a market share of 45% and a growth rate of 18%.

p1_b2.ocr: Total units sold comprised 10,000 electric cars at 20%, 7,000 hybrid cars at 14%, and 30,000 ICE cars at 66%, with total units sold of 52,000 at 100% and a total growth of 20% from 2020 to 2021, while from 2021 to 2022, electric growth was 25%, hybrid growth was 42%, and ICE growth was -33%. In the Dealer Inventory Levels, for the UK in 2020, there were 12,500 units, decreasing to 11,000 in 2021 and 9,500 in 2022, with a change of -10%, total inventory of 16,000, average price at £20K, and stock days at 45. Germany had 15,000 units in 2020, 14,000 in 2021, and 13,000 in 2022, with a -7% change, total inventory of 18,000, average price of £22K, and stock days at 50.
